0022600127.text: The Nuggets (1-1, 1-0 at home, on a W1 streak) host the Golden State Warriors (0-3, on a three-game losing streak) in a regular-season game that is Denver's third of the 2026-27 season, with Denver sitting 4th in the Northwest and 7th in the West. Denver is without Alpha Diallo (wrist), Cameron Johnson (ankle sprain), Julian Strawther (knee sprain), and Spencer Jones (hamstring), while Golden State is without Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), and Moses Moody (knee surgery). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27 and split their 2025-26 series 2-2, with Denver winning the last meeting 116-93 in Denver on March 29, 2026.
